title: Daylight Saving Time Survives In Only 36% Of Countries
hook: Only 36% of countries still observe daylight saving time.
closing: Clock changing is now a minority practice, even if it still feels normal locally.
question: Should your clocks stop changing?

segments.say: 64% of countries either abandoned daylight saving time or never adopted it. Changing clocks is now the minority practice.
Only 70 countries still observe it. The global count has fallen substantially.
India's 1.44 billion people do not use daylight saving time. Huge populations live without the seasonal switch.
